guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: Based on current visibility, and a U.S. dollar to Indian rupee exchange rate of 95, U.K. pound sterling to U.S. dollar exchange rate of 1.33, U.S. dollar to the Philippine peso exchange rate of 63 and all other currencies at current exchange rates, we are providing the following guidance for the full year 2026:
•Revenue of $2.430 billion to $2.440 billion, representing an increase of 16% to 17% on a reported basis, and 15% on an organic constant currency basis from 2025.
•Adjusted diluted earnings per share of $2.34 to $2.36, representing an increase of 20% to 21% from 2025.
